## About
Hon*Amotive is a repair and maintenance shop on N Cave Creek Rd in Phoenix. We specialize in Honda, Acura and all Japanese imports, and we handle everything from oil changes and tune-ups to major repairs. The one thing we don't do is body work.
Don Costa worked for dealerships before joining the shop, and he has spent his career working exclusively on Japanese cars. Our certified technicians care about getting the diagnosis right the first time. Mark Ottersberg owns the shop.
Customers have given us a 4.9 rating across 62 Google reviews. One reviewer said Don will let you know what needs to be done, not replace everything early.

## Services
- Preventative maintenance: Full service oil changes, tune-ups, tire care, mileage checkups and more to keep your car running well.
- Full service oil change: New oil and filter, plus a look at your brakes, suspension, fluid levels, tires, hoses, belts and CV boots.
- Transmission fluid exchange: Done on your car manufacturer's recommended schedule, and more often for cars that see stop and go traffic, towing or extreme heat.
- Radiator flush and fill: We check the cooling system for leaks, clear out rust and old coolant, and refill it with the right mix of water and coolant.
- Bumper to bumper repairs: Repairs on your whole car, with the exception of body work.

## FAQ
Q: Do you do body work?
A: No. We handle all major services and repairs, but body work is the one thing we don't do.

Q: What if my car can't make it to the shop?
A: Contact R & W Towing, LLC. They have existing accounts with Hon*Amotive, so getting your car to us is simple.

Q: Do you only work on Hondas?
A: No. We specialize in Honda and Acura and work on all Japanese imports. One reviewer mentioned that we work on Toyotas too.

Q: Can you help me find a used car?
A: Yes. Email us the make and model you have in mind and we'll let you know what's currently on the market.
